rows.en:
(I invited Ranka to come fly the EX-Gear
with me today, but...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_rnk_106; trailing kedo kept as 'but...'.

rows.en: Ranka, isn't it boring just watching?
Nuh-uh, not at all.
Well, if you say so.
rows.notes: Male; as the female twin c09167 (with ellipsis there).

rows.en: Okay then, I'm gonna go fly another round.
Go for it!

The EX-Gear is so amazing~
Doesn't it scare you?

It was scary at first, but I got used to it.
It's way more fun than not, anyway.

Why don't you give it a try too, Ranka?
Alto or Michel would teach you if you asked.
rows.notes: Male; bare names as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
What about you, \p-kun?
Won't you teach me?
rows.notes: Ranka, male scene; contrastive wa rendered 'What about you'.

rows.en: W-well, I'm really bad at teaching, so...

Aww, come on!
Teach me~
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; follows the male player's excuse and the female player's teasing 'should I?'.

rows.en:
(I invited Ranka-chan to come fly
the EX-Gear with me, but...)
Ranka-chan, isn't it boring just watching?

It was scary at first, but I got used to it.
It's way more fun than not, anyway~

Oh, I know! Why don't you try it too, Ranka-chan?
Saotome-kun or Michel-kun would teach you
if you asked.
rows.notes: Female; honorifics as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
What about you, \p-chan?
Won't you teach me?
Hmm~ Now, should I, I wonder?

(I invited Ranka to come fly the EX-Gear
with me again today, but...)

Ranka, is there anything you pick up on
watching me from down there?
rows.notes: Male; asking for her impressions of his flying.

rows.en:
Huh? I wouldn't know...
Even if you ask me something like that...

Even something tiny is fine.
Something about it just keeps bugging me.
rows.notes: Male; the player senses something off in his own flying.

rows.en:
I see...
Then this time I'll watch you really closely!
So, how did it look?

Hmm...
Hmmmm...
Hmm...
rows.notes: x4: Ranka here and Luca in nml_luk_016; generic.

rows.en: I dunno...
R-right... Yeah, that's my fault for asking...
rows.notes: Male; boku ga warukatta, 'for asking' added to make the self-blame clear.

rows.en:
(W-well, all in all, today was a nice
change of pace.)
rows.notes: Male; as the stock '(Today was a nice change of pace.)' plus the flustered stammer and ichinichi.

rows.en:
(I invited Ranka-chan to come fly the EX-Gear
with me again today, but...)

Ranka-chan, is there anything you pick up on
watching me from down there?

Even something tiny is fine.
Something about it just keeps bugging me...
R-right... Yeah, that's my fault for asking...

(W-well, all in all, today was a nice
change of pace.)
(I came to work out with Ranka today, but...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_rnk_107 (toreeningu: stretching and strength training).

rows.en: Let's give it our all today!
Wow, you're really fired up.

I may not look it, but I'm pretty athletic,
you know?

Are you, now?
Anyway, let's start with some stretches.
I'll go get changed first!!

Phew~ I went way too hard today.
I'm worn out.

You really were giving it your all.
I'm impressed.
(I came to work out with Ranka-chan today, but...)
Wow, you're really fired up, huh.

Oh, are you?
Anyway, let's start with some stretches.

You really were giving it your all~
I'm impressed.

(I came to work out with Ranka again today,
but...)

\p-kun,
sorry, I'm late...
So, what are we doing today?

Hmm, let's try putting some effort into
strength training.
Whaaat~!
Let's start with the light stuff.
Even getting changed was a struggle...
rows.notes: x2, Ranka, after the workout (sore muscles implied).

rows.en:
For someone who didn't want to,
you really gave it your all.
Ehehe... You think so?

(I came to work out with Ranka-chan again
today, but...)

\p-chan,
sorry, I'm late...
Let's start with something light.
Good work, Ranka-chan.

For someone who didn't want to,
you really gave it your all.

uncertain: c13276/c13286: 'nanika hikkakaru mono ga aru' read as the player feeling something is off about their own flying (why they ask Ranka for impressions).
c13307: Ranka's 'kigaeru no ga taihen datta' placed after the workout; read as sore muscles making even changing hard.
c13282/c13287: 'boku/watashi ga warukatta' rendered 'that's my fault for asking'.
